Our story

Built in a Shoreditch studio

Flexa started in 2020, when our coaches moved their classes online and members asked what to buy for a tiny flat. We tested every mat, band and dumbbell – and kept the best.

Every product still comes with a free training plan made by the same coaches.

Frequently asked

Where do I find my training plan?

It's emailed with your order confirmation and saved in your account.

Which dumbbells should I start with?

Most people start with 2 × 4 kg (women) or 2 × 8 kg (men).

Can I use the code FLEX10 twice?

It works once, on your first order.

Do you ship abroad?

To the EU and US, 3 – 6 working days.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay.
